core_obligations: Factor the structure morphism of X times Y as the projection to Y followed by the structure morphism of Y, and note that the projection is flat as a base change of the flat structure morphism of X (proof lines 4018-4024).
Identify the dimension of the fibre of the projection over y with the dimension of X at x by the base change formula for fibre dimensions (proof lines 4025-4026).
Apply additivity of fibre dimension along the flat projection to obtain the pointwise sum formula, and read off the global statement (proof lines 4027-4029).
proof_roadmap: Additivity and the global statement (proof lines 4027-4029).
difficulty_reason: For locally algebraic k-schemes X and Y, the lemma shows that the dimension of the product at a point is the sum of the dimensions at the two projections, and consequently that the dimension of the product is the sum of the dimensions (statement lines 4004-4015). The proof factors the structure morphism of the product through Y, observes that the projection to Y is flat because it is a base change of the flat structure morphism of X over a field, identifies the dimension of the fibre over the image point with the dimension of X at the corresponding point, and then applies the additivity of fibre dimension along a flat morphism (proof lines 4018-4028). The global statement is an immediate consequence. The claim is H2: three cited inputs combined along one factorization, with no construction beyond choosing the right projection.
